sessionHint: For the RainPoint app with a Wi-Fi gateway. The cloud allows only one active session per account. Create a second account and invite it as a home member so the phone app stays logged in.
areaCodeHelp: Phone country code of the account, e.g. 49 for Germany, 43 for Austria, 41 for Switzerland, 1 for USA.
homeIndexHelp: 0 = first home in the account. Increase if you have several homes.
